fields.label: Contract Title
fields.description: Business title of the contractor agreement as shown to users and reports.

fields.label: Contract Status
fields.options:
Draft
Under Review
Authorized
Approved
Active
Completed
Cancelled
Closed
fields.description: Operational status of this contractor agreement.

fields.label: Negotiated Amount
fields.description: Legacy total amount kept for compatibility; updated from Total Agreement Amount.

fields.label: Remaining Amount
fields.description: Legacy remaining amount kept for compatibility; updated from agreement progress.

fields.label: Agreement Items
fields.description: Agreement item rows linked to BOQ Work Items, measurement, and IPC progress.

fields.label: Terms
fields.description: Legacy terms and conditions retained for compatibility.

fields.label: Agreement Number
fields.description: Commercial agreement number used to identify the contractor agreement.

fields.label: Agreement Date
fields.description: Date when the contractor agreement was agreed or issued.

fields.label: Agreement Type
fields.options:
Unit Rate
Lump Sum
Labor Only
Material & Labor
Other
fields.description: Commercial pricing basis agreed with the contractor.

fields.label: Workflow State
fields.options:
Draft
Under Review
Authorized
Approved
Active
Completed
Cancelled
Closed
fields.description: Workflow state used to track agreement review, approval, activation, and closure.

fields.label: Construction BOQ
fields.description: Approved BOQ that defines the planned scope covered by this contractor agreement.

fields.label: Scope Summary
fields.description: Short business summary of the work scope included in this contractor agreement.

fields.label: Total Agreement Amount
fields.description: Total agreed amount calculated automatically from agreement item rows.

fields.label: Measured Amount
fields.description: Total measured amount calculated automatically from linked Measurement Entries.

fields.label: Certified Amount
fields.description: Total certified amount calculated automatically from linked IPC lines.

fields.label: Invoiced Amount
fields.description: Total invoiced amount read from linked contractor Purchase Invoices where available.

fields.label: Remaining Agreement Amount
fields.description: Agreement amount remaining after certified work, calculated automatically.

fields.label: Measured Percent
fields.description: Measured progress percentage calculated automatically against the agreement amount.

fields.label: Certified Percent
fields.description: Certified progress percentage calculated automatically against the agreement amount.

fields.label: Retention Percent
fields.description: Retention percentage applied to contractor IPCs for this agreement.

fields.label: Advance Amount
fields.description: Operational advance amount agreed with the contractor. No accounting entry is created by this field.

fields.label: Penalty Terms
fields.description: Summary of penalty terms agreed with the contractor.

fields.label: Payment Terms
fields.description: Commercial payment terms for the contractor agreement.

fields.label: Guarantee Terms
fields.description: Guarantee or performance bond terms agreed with the contractor.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.description: Additional notes for this contractor agreement.

fields.label: Expected End Date
fields.description: Expected completion date for the contractor agreement.
